name: stats-every-numeric-aggregate
spl: program=sshd | stats count, dc(user) as users, sum(bytes) as total, avg(bytes) as mean, min(status) as lo, max(status) as hi by host

expect.sql: SELECT host AS `host.name`, count() AS `c0`, uniqExactIf(user_name, notEmpty(user_name)) AS `c1`, sum(http_response_body_bytes) AS `c2`, avg(http_response_body_bytes) AS `c3`, minIf(http_status, http_status != 0) AS `c4`, maxIf(http_status, http_status != 0) AS `c5` FROM events_v WHERE case_id = {case:UInt64} AND ts >= {from:DateTime64(3)} AND ts < {to:DateTime64(3)} AND (program = {p0:String}) AND notEmpty(host) GROUP BY host
